description: This Java class 'MigrationServices' provides a service method 'migrateProductPromoCodeEmail' to migrate product promo code email data, involving database queries, validation, and creation of contact mechanisms within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: MigrationServices
classes.description: A service class providing migration functions related to product promo codes within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: migrateProductPromoCodeEmail
methods.description: Migrates email addresses associated with product promo codes by validating, creating contact mechanisms, and linking them to promo codes.
